name: Taktek merch
headline: You can't just buy these.
intro: Twenty things from ordinary life at home. Each one has to be won first. Win it, and it's yours to buy.

pieces.name: told you so. cap
pieces.challenge: Say it at exactly the right moment, three times.

pieces.name: the spare key hoodie
pieces.line: the spare key was never spare.
pieces.challenge: Find the spare key.

pieces.name: five more minutes blanket
pieces.challenge: Snooze, then don't move for five real minutes.

pieces.name: fix it this weekend apron
pieces.challenge: Opens on weekends only, your time.

pieces.name: first one up mug
pieces.challenge: Turn the alarm off before anyone else wakes. Three mornings.

pieces.name: food at home tote
pieces.challenge: Let everything roll past. Take only the tote.

pieces.name: on my way tee
pieces.challenge: Ten seconds to find your keys, phone, wallet and sunglasses.

pieces.name: did you lock the door beanie
pieces.challenge: Lock up, drive off, and go back to check.

pieces.name: ask your mother crewneck
pieces.challenge: Break the loop.

pieces.name: we're not lost bucket hat
pieces.challenge: Get out of the maze without asking for directions.

pieces.name: leave the light on candle
pieces.challenge: Keep the flame alive for thirty seconds.

pieces.name: just one more cards
pieces.challenge: Higher or lower. Walk away while you're ahead.

pieces.name: i'll dry towel
pieces.challenge: Dry twelve plates in a row.

pieces.name: one sec clock
pieces.challenge: Stop the clock at exactly one second.

pieces.name: wifi password magnets
pieces.line: the wifi password is on the fridge.
pieces.challenge: Find the wifi password on the fridge.

pieces.name: the good side pillow
pieces.challenge: Keep the pillow cool all night.

pieces.name: thermostat sweater
pieces.challenge: Hold the house at 22° for twenty seconds.

pieces.name: just a splash glass
pieces.challenge: Pour a splash. Just a splash.

pieces.name: it's not tennis paddles
pieces.challenge: Ten returns in a row.

pieces.name: the last piece puzzle
pieces.challenge: Solve the puzzle.
